observation.command:
cd /workspace/app
# Kill the broken just serve (bracket trick to avoid self-match)
pkill -f "[s]erve.mjs" 2>/dev/null
sleep 3
# Start app (34237) and cms (35581); boards (38377) already running directly
nohup pnpm nx serve app --configuration=instance --port=34237 --host=0.0.0.0 --allowedHosts=app.workspace.localhost > /tmp/app-direct.log 2>&1 &
echo "app pid $!"
nohup pnpm nx serve cms --configuration=instance --port=35581 --host=0.0.0.0 --allowedHosts=cms.workspace.localhost > /tmp/cms-direct.log 2>&1 &
echo "cms pid $!"
sleep 5; echo "started"
